noWebsite_initial.subject: A website for {{Company}}
noWebsite_initial.text:
Hi {{First Name}},

I'm {{Sender Name}} from Aethelon Studio. I build websites for independent stores.

Would a simple website for {{Company}} be useful? It could give customers a place to browse your products, find your opening hours and get in touch. If you'd like to sell online, we can talk about that too.

I can send over a few ideas and a clear scope before you decide.

Some of my work: {{Portfolio}}

Is this something you've been thinking about?

Best,
{{Sender Name}}

noWebsite_followUp1.subject: Re: A website for {{Company}}
noWebsite_followUp1.text:
Hi {{First Name}},

Just following up on my note about a website for {{Company}}.

We could start small with your products, opening hours and contact details, then add online orders if that makes sense for your store.

Would you like me to send a short outline?

Best,
{{Sender Name}}

noWebsite_followUp2.subject: What would be useful for {{Company}}?
noWebsite_followUp2.text:
Hi {{First Name}},

If you're considering a website, would you mainly want customers to find the store, browse products or place orders online?

That would help me suggest something practical for {{Company}} and give you a clear estimate.

Best,
{{Sender Name}}

noWebsite_followUp3.subject: A simple starting point
noWebsite_followUp3.text:
Hi {{First Name}},

You wouldn't need to put your whole catalog online to get started. A small selection of products, store details and a way to ask questions could be enough for a first version.

If that sounds useful for {{Company}}, I'm happy to talk through it.

Best,
{{Sender Name}}

noWebsite_breakup.subject: I'll leave it here
noWebsite_breakup.text:
Hi {{First Name}},

I'll leave it here after this note. If a website becomes a priority for {{Company}}, feel free to get in touch.

And if you already have one that I've missed, you're welcome to send me the link.

Best,
{{Sender Name}}
